verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each step of the story. Dedicated Board Consent and Stockholder Consent workflows create written consents and solicit approvals, and generative workflows produce documents to execute on the platform. Signers get an emailed link to sign in-platform. Signed documents are automatically archived in the data room and smart-linked to the transactions they authorize, such as award agreements tied to their corresponding board consent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the consent drafting, routing and linking flow.
